data.title: 西连寺春菜 · 落地穿衣镜前的侧影对视
data.action: 侧身站在落地镜前轻抚耳后短发，镜中反射与门外视线相触，慌忙侧头双手轻收
data.lighting: 窗外傍晚暮色柔光与室内落地灯交融，镜面映出双重光影
data.location: 春菜卧室角落的木框椭圆落地穿衣镜前
data.description: 黄昏的卧房角落，椭圆形落地镜前。春菜侧立在木地板上正整理衣着，镜子清晰映照出她轻挽耳发的身影。突然在镜中与站在门边的观众视线相撞，她像受惊的小鹿般僵在原地，整个人从耳垂红到脖颈。
data.promptProse: Standing barefoot in three-quarter profile before a wooden-framed oval dressing mirror at dusk, Haruna Sairenji wears delicate pale-blue cotton-and-lace lingerie with tiny ribbon bows. Raising one hand to tuck her hair behind her ear, she tenses in startled bashful surprise the instant her eyes meet the viewer's reflection in the glass.
data.nsfwProse: She wears delicate pale-blue cotton-and-lace lingerie accented with dainty ribbon bows on the bra and matching panties, standing barefoot before the glass.
data.animaCaption: Standing sideways barefoot before her tall oval mirror in dainty pale-blue lace-and-ribbon lingerie, she freezes mid-tuck behind her ear with a startled crimson blush as her eyes meet the viewer's reflection in the glass. Soft dusk window light blends with warm floor-lamp glow.
